title: Does multinma's split-chain integration check flag material integration error in a flexible survival ML-NMR contrast?
question: In survival ML-NMR with Weibull or M-spline baselines, 4 or 12 aggregate studies and 5 covariates, how often does residual integration error move the transported log hazard ratio by a quarter of a posterior SD or more, and how often does the split-chain check that runs half the chains at half the points detect it?
design: Posterior modes on multinma's own log density along a nested Sobol ladder from 4 to 512 points against a 1024-point reference; the split-chain check emulated from the shift of every saved quantity and validated against real fits; a Laplace prefix check as candidate. 6 cells, 50 datasets each (10 in the validation cell).
